The boundary between the cake base and the wooden surface is slightly blurred and indistinct, suggesting a minor grounding issue or 'melting' where the object meets the table.
The black metal window frame lines show slight waviness and inconsistency in thickness, which is atypical for rigid architectural elements, though subtle.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'plastic' look of the frosting. Real buttercream usually has micro-texture; AI often smoothes this out. Also, check if the window frame in the background maintains straight lines, as AI often warps rigid geometric structures in bokeh areas.
